176-4875-5256.easyPrerequisites:

Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.

When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.

When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Evereth ability.

1445-4871-6351-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Cast Kirol either from your hand or the command zone by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W} plus commander tax, if applicable.

Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating three token copies of Kirol with haste.

Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.

Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1732-2103-2971-3662-3904.notablePrerequisites: Initiate's Companion does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1732-2103-2971-3662-3904.description:
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Late to Dinner from your graveyard.
Declare Initiate's Companion as an attacker.
Finest Hour's exalted and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first Finest Hour trigger, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second Finest Hour trigger, untapping Initiate's Companion and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Initiate's Companion.
Initiate's Companion triggers, untapping Izzet Chemister.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard.

Finest Hour's exalted ability triggers, giving Initiate's Companion +1/+1 until end of turn.

Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve Late to Dinner, returning Izzet Chemister from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Food token.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the copy of Zethi's ability, creating a copy of each card exiled with a kick counter of it and causing you to pay {1}{W} to cast the copy of Roar of the Kha.

Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use that mana to then cast the copies of all other cards exiled with kick counters on them.
